_doc: GENERATED by tools/read_blackhawk_war.py --build. A PROPOSAL, not a decision: every one of the 134 enrollments set beside the 1833-1835 poll and tax lists under the rule at the head of that file. Nothing here merges anybody, and nothing here regrades a resident.

outcomes.corroborated: The surname agrees and one reading of the forenames agrees initial for initial. The same NAME stands on both; whether it is the same MAN is a judgement this pass does not make.
outcomes.ambiguous: Contested in one direction or the other: either more than one distinct reading on the lists agrees with the index row, or more than one index row agrees with the same entry. A candidate, never a merge.
outcomes.unmatched: Either no entry carries the surname, or one does and no forename reading agrees. Refusals of the second kind are written into crosswalk.json.
outcomes.no_surname: The index prints the name without a surname comma — the French and Potawatomi forms. Carried and counted; a surname crosswalk cannot reach it.

entries.rule: 2 different readings of the surname 'ADAMS' agree with the index initial for initial (W. H. Adams, William H. Adams) and nothing printed in either row separates them; an ambiguous agreement is a candidate, never a merge.
